description: This file defines the TypedDataManager class in Drupal, responsible for managing data type plugins, creating data instances, handling validation, and caching data definitions.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\TypedData\TypedDataManager
classes.description: Manages data type plugins, creates data instances, handles validation, and manages data definitions within Drupal.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates a new data type plugin instance based on the specified data type and configuration.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a typed data object based on a data definition, optional value, name, and parent object.

methods.name: createDataDefinition
methods.description: Creates a data definition object for a given data type.

methods.name: createListDataDefinition
methods.description: Creates a list data definition for a specified item type.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves a property instance for a given object, property name, and value.

methods.name: getPropertyInstance
methods.description: Returns a property instance, reusing prototypes for performance.

methods.name: setValidator
methods.description: Sets the validator used for validating typed data.

methods.name: getValidator
methods.description: Retrieves the validator, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setValidationConstraintManager
methods.description: Sets the constraint manager for validation constraints.

methods.name: getValidationConstraintManager
methods.description: Returns the current validation constraint manager.

methods.name: getDefaultConstraints
methods.description: Returns default validation constraints for a data definition.

methods.name: clearCachedDefinitions
methods.description: Clears cached data definitions and prototypes.

methods.name: getCanonicalRepresentation
methods.description: Returns the canonical representation of a typed data object.
